summary: Israeli forces conducted targeted strikes in southern Lebanon, including the killing of a Hezbollah battalion commander in the Ansar area. In Gaza, an IDF tank was struck by a Hamas explosive device near the Yellow Line. Tensions remain high as both sides report ceasefire violations.
key_points: The IDF killed Ali Samir al-Haj Hassan, a battalion commander in Hezbollah's Radwan Unit, during a strike on a central command headquarters in the Ansar area of southern Lebanon (Source: @idf_telegram/24904).
An IDF tank was struck by a Hamas explosive device during Givati Brigade operations near the Yellow Line in the southern Gaza Strip, resulting in no injuries (Source: @manniefabian/58974).
Israeli forces killed two operatives who crossed the Yellow Line in an attempt to sabotage IDF weapons near the southern Gaza Strip (Source: @manniefabian/58974).
Israeli artillery targeted Jabal al-Rafie on the outskirts of Sajd in southern Lebanon (Source: @presstv/202937).
Israeli airstrikes were reported in Deir al-Zahrani, north of Nabatieh, in southern Lebanon (Source: @yediotnews25/133945).
A Hezbollah explosive drone struck Israeli forces in southern Lebanon, resulting in one officer and two soldiers being seriously injured (Source: @inon_yttach/9861).
Israeli forces conducted raids and opened fire on a Palestinian wedding party in Qarawat Bani Zeid, northwest of Ramallah (Source: @presstv/202916).
Palestinian officials in Gaza warned of an unprecedented health catastrophe due to the potential shutdown of oxygen generation facilities (Source: @presstv/202951).

sections.threat_assessment: The operational environment is characterized by active combat and ceasefire violations. Hezbollah's Radwan Unit remains capable of conducting drone strikes against IDF forces, resulting in casualties. Hamas continues to utilize explosive devices against armored vehicles in the southern Gaza Strip.
sections.regional_response: The IDF has indicated it views recent ceasefire violations gravely and intends to respond. International humanitarian concerns are rising in Gaza regarding the collapse of medical infrastructure and oxygen supply.
sections.intelligence_notes: The killing of a high-ranking Hezbollah battalion commander in the Ansar area represents a significant tactical strike. The use of explosive devices against IDF tanks near the Yellow Line indicates continued asymmetric capabilities by Hamas.
